requirements:
- `demo/film.js`: `IT` (objects: centre, rotation, scale), `toW()` / `toT()` (texture ↔ world), `CAM` keys and `w2s()`, `dive()` (loupe point, land/lift times, lens interior as tracks), `shot(t)`, `int2s()` (photograph → screen for marks), the shader (`lightTable`, `paper`, `negative`, `parallax`, rim and skirt), the overlay (`annot`, `measure`, `compare`, `indexPanel`).
- `demo/tools/prep.py`: emulsion masks from scans, difference matting of a subject against a smooth sky, ground-only cuts, push-pull fill.
- Minimal example, not in the demo: put one 35 mm slide (`IT.slide = {c, r, k, size}`), a loupe landing with `dive(toW(IT.slide, p), t0, t1, keysS, keysC)`, and light one line with `band()`.
- **Extra packages and packs**: none beyond `setup.sh deps voice music` (numpy, scipy, Pillow, soxr are in the core tier). A score in this palette needs sample libraries: `sh tools/fetch.sh instruments salamander` (piano), `vsco2ce` (strings), `vcsl` (glass, bowed vibraphone). Anything else a film needs goes into a private venv or `node_modules` in the project folder, never into `$LIB/.venv`.

- **Photos**: Wikimedia Commons (read each file page's licence and author), national libraries and archives (e.g. the Library of Congress: check each item's rights statement), agency media pages, Flickr Commons. Fine: CC0, public domain, CC BY (credit it). CC BY-SA, "no known restrictions" (≠ CC0) or other terms: name them to the user and ask first. For the user's own product, site or people, ask for their photos. No licensable photo of a real thing → draw it in marker as a sketch; never a generated image presented as the real object.
- **Facts**: keep a `FACTS.md` in the project folder (each claim on screen or in the voice, its source URL, the quoted wording, or the measurement method) and deliver it with the film. List every photo in `CREDITS` with source, author and licence.
- **Extra packages and packs** (beyond `setup.sh deps voice music`): `onnxruntime` and the BiRefNet-general matting model (MIT, ~970 MB: https://github.com/danielgatis/rembg/releases/download/v0.0.0/BiRefNet-general-epoch_244.onnx, path in `$BIREFNET_ONNX`) for cut-outs; `fonttools` only to subset CJK fonts offline. The agent installs them itself into a private venv in the project folder (`demo/kit/tools/kit_env.sh` does venv and model), never into `$LIB/.venv`. Without the model: cut with `prep_object.py --poly` (hand polygon) or `--mask` (a mask image).
- **Engine** (copy into the project): `demo/kit/board.js` (camera, prints, tags, magnets, ruler, cards, stamp, ink, erasing, `sceneTexts(t)`, `subCheck()`; fields in `demo/kit/README.md`), `demo/kit/batch.mjs` (stills), `demo/kit/tools/` (cut-outs, line redraws, lettering wipe, prints, fonts), checks in `demo/tools/` (`camcheck.mjs` visible share and judgement frames, `rescheck.mjs`, `subcheck.mjs`).

- `demo/set.js` — `buildSet(scene)` (HDRI, warm key + cool rims, base with inlay canvas, instanced pieces per material, the last object) and the landing schedule (`SHEETS`, `EVENTS`, `landed(stack, t)`); change `PAIRS`, the unit and the materials for any single or paired series.
- `demo/film.js` — cylindrical camera keys (`track`, `core/lib.js`) with focus on a target point, the reading kit (`pairLabels`, `verdict`, `plate`, `swatch`), counter, subtitles (`SUBCHECK`), `TEXTS`, `EV`. `demo/mix.py` — material foley (`tick_alu`, `tok_acr`), ruler notes, suck-outs, master.
- **Extra packages and packs**: beyond `setup.sh deps` only the studio HDRI, `sh tools/fetch.sh hdri` (Poly Haven, CC0, 12 MB); with narration `setup.sh deps voice`; for a sampled score `sh tools/fetch.sh instruments vsco2ce` / `vcsl` / `freepats`. The walnut veneer is in `core/assets/polyhaven/`. Anything you add (a spreadsheet reader, other textures) goes into a private venv / node_modules in the project folder, never into `$LIB/.venv`.
- Minimal example, not in the demo: one series of twelve monthly values on a 12-position circle, the annual total engraved on the last object.

- `demo/film.js`: point shader (front, cutting plane, lift, ghost, window), surface shader (light, AO, contours, feature field, section), photo shader, camera spline (`camAt`), overlay (`reading`, `drawSection`, `subtitles`, readcheck registry).
- `demo/tools/`: `fetch_ept.py` (EPT subset), `terrain.py` (local frame, DTM), `walls.py` (relief model), `trace.py` (snap a tracing, measure), `profile.py` (section from raw returns), `build_data.py` (binaries + facts).
- **Extra packages and packs** (beyond `setup.sh deps voice music`): Python `laspy`, `lazrs` (LAZ decoding), `scikit-image` (relief and ridge tools), `fonttools` + `brotli` (CJK subset). They are not in the library's `.venv`: the agent installs them itself into a private venv in the project folder (the demo uses `demo/assets/raw/.venv`), never into `$LIB/.venv`. Fonts come from github.com/google/fonts (ofl/), fetched by script.
- Minimal example, not in the demo: a building scan. Points coloured by class, a vertical front sweeping the street; behind it a 1 m surface model; one reading (roof height above the street).

- `demo/film.js`: log-spiral camera (`camAt`), plate selection by downsampling ratio and coverage, objective events from real level changes, focus, frosted `panel()`, marks, readings, `TEXTS` / `SUBCHECK` / `EV`.
- `demo/tools/plates.py`: slide-photo registration and cleaning, graded plates, collagen mask and the scan's cumulative curve, the tissue axis. `nucleus.py`: membrane edge on 72 rays, least-squares circle.
- **Extra packages and packs** (beyond `setup.sh deps voice`): `tifffile` + `imagecodecs` read TIFF-based slides (Ventana BIF, Aperio SVS, Hamamatsu NDPI, generic pyramidal TIFF; `demo/tools/plates.py` is written for BIF: its label page, XMP and AOI); MRXS, SCN, VMS and others need `openslide-python` with the OpenSlide library (`brew install openslide`), or an adapter of your own. Install them yourself into a private venv in the project folder, not into `$LIB/.venv`.
- Minimal example, not in the demo: a coated steel sample: one SEM pyramid, a dive to one crack, a circle counting coverage, a ring around one grain.

- `demo/engine.js`: `makeCamera({lat, lon, d, tilt, heading, sx, sy})`, `project()` / `unproject()`, the WebGL2 plate shader (nested plates, time scans, growth map, analyst grade, printed-map layer, whip blur).
- `demo/overlay.js`: hairlines, brackets, `readout`, the measured single-line `subtitle` strip, `text` with a registry for `window.TEXTS`.
- `demo/tools/`: `fetch_landsat.py` (STAC, one date per path, same-year gap fill), `plates.py` (normalisation, streak cleaning, water masks, areas), `vectors.py` (shorelines, distances), `mapfield.py` (the printed map), `growth.py`.
- **Extra packages and packs**: none beyond `setup.sh deps voice` and the sample packs the score uses (`sh tools/fetch.sh instruments <lib>` for vsco2ce, vcsl, freepats in the demo). Imagery uses only the standard library, numpy, SciPy, Pillow (no GDAL); allow 3–4 GB for cached scenes. Anything more (rasterio, pyproj) goes in a private venv in the project folder, not `$LIB/.venv`.

**Extra packages and packs**, beyond `setup.sh deps [voice] [music]`: `occt-import-js` (npm, LGPL-2.1, not in the library's package.json) to triangulate STEP files, and the studio HDRI (`sh tools/fetch.sh hdri`). Install the npm package yourself into a private `node_modules` in the project folder (as `tools/fetch_cad.sh` does in a temp folder), never into `$LIB`.

- `demo/studio.js` — `makeStudio(W, H, model)`: renderer, post, room, the projection material (`projMaterial(kind)` injects `projLight()` / `roofGlow()` into MeshStandardMaterial), the city mesh (`buildCity`: outward normals, shared walls removed), plate, plinth, house light (index 0) and sun (index 1). Uniforms `U` drive every layer.
- `demo/tools/prep.py` — **3DBAG + BGT only**: it reads 3DBAG fields (`b3_h_70p`, `b3_h_maaiveld`, `oorspronkelijkbouwjaar`) and Dutch RD coordinates (`tools/rd.py`). Another source needs its own adapter that writes the same `model.json`: `{size:[w,d] model metres, b:[[year|0, height_m], …] per building, p:[[building_index, height_model_m, [[[x,z],…] outer ring, …holes]], …] per roof part, decks:[[[x,z],…]]}`, with x east, z south, 1 unit = 1 model metre; plus `water.png` (plate-sized mask) and a `stats.json` with every on-screen number. `tools/sun.py` (solar position, any place and date) and the heightfield shadow are source-independent.
- `demo/overlay.js` — readout, pin, measured range line, subtitle strip, title card; registers texts for readcheck.
- **Extra packages and packs**: none beyond `setup.sh deps` (+ `voice`, `music` for narration and score); downloads are plain `curl` from the data portal. Reprojecting another country's data may need pyproj or shapely: the agent installs them itself into a private venv in the project folder, not into `$LIB/.venv`.
- Minimal example, not in the demo: set `U.uPreC` to a station and `U.uPreR` growing to light everything within walking distance; or put a flood height in `U.uHgtF` with `U.uHgtBand` held at 1 and leave it still.
